# omniddi_dns_view (Data Source)

Reads one DNS view by id or by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_dns_view" "by_name" {
  name = "internal"
}

data "omniddi_dns_view" "by_id" {
  id = 12
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The OmniDDI view id. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.
- `name` (String) View name. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`.

### Read-Only

- `allow_query_acl_id` (Number) Id of the allow-query ACL.
- `allow_recursion_acl_id` (Number) Id of the allow-recursion ACL.
- `allow_update_acl_id` (Number) Id of the allow-update ACL.
- `created_on` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) View description.
- `forward_only` (Boolean) Whether the view only uses its forwarders.
- `forwarders` (Attributes List) View forwarders; null when the view inherits the server forwarders. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--forwarders))
- `match_destinations_acl_id` (Number) Id of the match-destinations ACL.
- `match_recursive_only` (Boolean) Whether only recursive queries select the view.
- `max_cache_ttl` (Number) `max-cache-ttl` in seconds.
- `max_ncache_ttl` (Number) `max-ncache-ttl` in seconds.
- `priority` (Number) Match priority; a lower number is matched first.
- `recursion` (Boolean) Per-view recursion setting; null when the view inherits the server setting.
- `server_group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the server groups that publish the view.
- `tags` (Map of String) Single-valued tags on the view. Not populated by the plural data source.
- `tags_list` (Map of List of String) Multi-valued tags on the view. Not populated by the plural data source.
- `updated_on` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `view_acl_id` (Number) Id of the ACL that selects clients for the view.
- `zone_count` (Number) Number of zones in the view.

<a id="nestedatt--forwarders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `forwarders`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) Forwarder address.
- `port` (Number) Forwarder port.
